jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Production Director – Seasonal Content to join our MONOPOLY GO! team. This role can be based remotely in the UK or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—whether through our work alongside exceptional teammates or through unforgettable experiences for millions of players. We're a global team of game makers building one of the world's most successful live-service games.

As the Production Director – Seasonal Content, you'll own the operational health, planning, and execution behind MONOPOLY GO!'s seasonal content portfolio. You'll partner across Art, Design, Product, Live Operations, Licensing, and Content teams to ensure every season delivers exceptional quality, creative novelty, operational excellence, and measurable player impact.

Success in this role goes beyond shipping content on schedule. You'll be accountable for the health of the seasonal ecosystem—including content capacity, creative ambition, production predictability, IP integration, execution quality, and the cross-functional alignment required to consistently deliver industry-leading live-service seasons.

This role requires an exceptional balance of strategic leadership and tactical execution. You'll be equally comfortable shaping long-term organizational strategy with senior leadership as you are rolling up your sleeves with producers, artists, designers, and engineers to solve production challenges, unblock teams, and improve execution day-to-day.

What You'll Do

Lead production for the Seasonal Content organization, overseeing the planning, execution, and successful delivery of every MONOPOLY GO! season.
Own the operational health of the seasonal portfolio, balancing player experience, content quality, novelty, production predictability, resource utilization, and business objectives—not simply delivery against schedule.
Drive the long-term evolution of the seasonal content pipeline, continuously improving how art, design, narrative, gameplay content, rewards, licensed IP, localization, and live operations move from concept through launch.
Own content roadmap planning, art capacity planning, outsourcing strategy, and resource forecasting to maximize both creative ambition and sustainable execution.
Partner closely with Product, Art, Design, Live Operations, Marketing, and Licensing leadership to align priorities across multiple concurrent seasonal initiatives.
Operate comfortably at both the executive and production floor levels—providing strategic direction while remaining actively involved in milestone reviews, dependency management, issue resolution, production planning, and critical decision making.
Be willing to get "in the weeds" with producers and development teams to remove blockers, resolve ambiguity, improve workflows, and ensure teams have what they need to succeed.
Lead cross-functional planning for major seasonal launches, proactively identifying execution risks, staffing challenges, dependency conflicts, and operational gaps before they impact delivery.
Drive executive-level visibility through clear reporting, production health metrics, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations.
Champion continuous improvement across production methodologies, governance, tooling, AI adoption, and content development workflows.
Lead organizational change initiatives that improve how teams plan, collaborate, and execute, ensuring new processes are successfully adopted across multiple disciplines.
Serve as a diplomatic leader who builds trust across diverse teams, navigates competing priorities with empathy, and facilitates alignment during high-pressure or ambiguous situations.
Mentor Production Managers and Producers while raising the overall maturity and effectiveness of production across the Seasonal Content organization.

What We're Looking For

Extensive experience leading production within large-scale live-service game development environments.
Deep expertise managing content-heavy production pipelines, including art production, outsourcing, IP development, localization, approvals, and live seasonal releases.
Demonstrated success operating as a Production Director or equivalent leader responsible for both organizational strategy and execution.
Proven ability to seamlessly shift between strategic leadership and hands-on production management, remaining deeply connected to execution while guiding long-term organizational direction.
Strong expertise in production planning, capacity planning, portfolio management, dependency mapping, forecasting, and operational excellence.
Exceptional understanding of creative development pipelines and how to optimize art and content production without sacrificing quality or innovation.
Outstanding diplomacy and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve conflict constructively, and build alignment across diverse disciplines without relying on direct authority.
Experience leading organizations through meaningful operational change, including introducing new production processes, organizational structures, tools, or ways of working while driving strong adoption.
Excellent judgment balancing player experience, creative ambition, technical constraints, production risk, and business priorities.
Outstanding communication, organizational leadership, and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with rapidly evolving priorities and complex cross-functional organizations.
Passion for building high-performing teams, enabling creative excellence, and delivering unforgettable seasonal experiences at world-class scale.

AI Capability & Readiness

We believe AI will fundamentally transform how content organizations operate. In this role, you'll be expected to actively incorporate AI into production workflows to improve planning, asset tracking, documentation, communication, forecasting, content review, dependency management, and operational decision-making. You'll champion thoughtful AI adoption across the Seasonal Content organization, helping teams work faster, make better decisions, and increase creative capacity without compromising quality. We value leaders who are curious, experimental, and capable of driving organizational change as AI reshapes game development.

Bonus Points

Experience working on category-leading live service games.
Experience within mobile free-to-play game development.
Experience leading globally distributed development teams.
Experience scaling production organizations during periods of rapid growth.
Familiarity with modern AI productivity tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar, and experience applying them to production workflows.
Experience evolving production operating models, governance frameworks, or portfolio planning processes.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the ads that introduce Kit & Kin to thousands of new customers?
Co-founded by Spice Girl Emma Bunton, Kit & Kin is a certified B Corp creating everyday essentials for families, with award-winning baby and cleaning products sold through DTC, Amazon and retail channels.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to own our paid social creative strategy, track and analyse ad performance, and turn those insights into stronger advertising.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines creative thinking with analytical confidence and wants real ownership, autonomy and impact within a growing ecommerce brand.

THE ROLE:

You’ll take ownership of the creative development and performance analysis behind our paid social advertising, with Meta as your primary focus.

You’ll be accountable for understanding which ads, hooks, messages and formats are working, which are underperforming and what we should do next. You’ll use those findings to develop successful formats further, improve weaker concepts and identify fresh creative opportunities.

Working closely with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, internal creative team and external creators, you’ll take ideas from customer insight through scripting, briefing, production and testing. You’ll help us make more of our founder, expert, creator and product content across nappies, wipes, skincare and cleaning.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys writing a compelling script as much as analysing the results. You’ll own creative reporting and recommendations, partnering with performance marketing to translate better creative into more efficient customer acquisition.

RESPONSABILITIES:

Creative performance tracking and analysis

Own our ad creative performance tracker and weekly reporting, clearly identifying what is working, what isn’t and the recommended next steps.
Establish consistent naming and tagging to compare performance by concept, format, hook, message, creator and product.
Analyse CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, click-through rate and video engagement alongside spend to understand commercial outcomes and where ads lose attention.
Investigate results with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, accounting for differences in audience, placement, offer, landing page and the amount of data available.
Identify emerging winners and signs of creative fatigue, and turn findings into prioritised recommendations and production briefs.

Creative strategy and testing

Own a creative testing roadmap aligned with commercial priorities, product launches, and production capacity.
Define clear hypotheses and agree success measures for each test with performance marketing.
Develop successful formats further through new hooks, scripts, creators, lengths and product angles.
Diagnose underperforming creative and recommend specific improvements, further testing or retirement.
Document results and learnings so each round of creative builds on the last.

Concepts, copy and production

Research customer reviews, surveys, social comments and customer service feedback to uncover motivations, objections and opportunities.
Develop concepts for video, static and carousel ads, including demonstrations, testimonials, founder stories, expert advice and offers.
Work with a copywriter to create compelling hooks, scripts, headlines and calls to action that communicate product benefits clearly in our brand voice.
Brief creators, copywriters, editors and designers with clear direction on the audience, message, opening, footage and intended test.
Plan scripts and shot lists for founder, expert and product shoots, and repurpose existing footage into fresh ads.
Give actionable feedback on storytelling, pacing, visuals and messaging, keeping production moving to agreed deadlines.
Ensure creative follows our product claims and brand guidelines, with appropriate usage permissions confirmed.
Stay informed about competitor advertising, platform developments and emerging formats to identify relevant opportunities.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

3+ years’ relevant experience in performance creative strategy, paid social or a related role within an ecommerce brand or agency.
Proven experience developing paid social creative for DTC or ecommerce brands, particularly on Meta.
Hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager to track, analyse and compare performance at ad level.
A portfolio demonstrating how you have used results to improve creative, with clear examples of your contribution and the impact.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including confidence with Excel or Google Sheets.
A sound understanding of CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion and video engagement metrics, including their limitations.
Experience designing creative tests and translating findings into new concepts and iterations.
Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills, with the ability to write engaging hooks and natural, persuasive scripts.
Experience briefing creators, video editors and designers and providing constructive creative feedback.
Strong commercial understanding of customer acquisition and the role of creative in ecommerce growth.
Excellent organisation, communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to take ownership and challenge assumptions.

NICE TO HAVES:

Experience with subscription ecommerce businesses or family, skincare and household products.
Experience with TikTok creative, creator partnership ads or directing shoots.
Understanding of landing page messaging and conversion rate optimisation.
Practical video editing or design skills.
Experience using AI tools to support research, ideation, analysis or production workflows.

WHAT YOU'LL GET:

Competitive salary depending on experience
25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
Fully remote work with monthly meetings in London.
40% staff discount across Kit & Kin products.
Regular team socials.
Statutory pension scheme.
Significant autonomy and ownership.
Opportunity to play a key role in scaling a purpose-driven brand.

JOIN US ON OUR JOURNEY

We’re looking for someone curious, commercially minded and passionate about improving advertising through strong ideas and clear evidence.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape Kit & Kin’s creative and see the impact of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

Please include your CV and two or three examples of paid social creative you’ve worked on, explaining your contribution, the results and how you used those findings to develop the creative further. Anonymised results are welcome where information is confidential.

With a powerhouse portfolio
across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

LADbible’s Commercial Team, LAD360, is a powerhouse of creativity, strategy, and innovation - partnering with the world’s most iconic brands, from Google and Nike to Disney and Tesco. With a headcount of 150 and growing, LAD360 has rapidly become one of the most formidable forces in media, delivering culture-shaping campaigns. Our work has earned us top industry accolades, including Commercial Team of the Year
at the 2025 Campaign UK Awards and Media Brand of the Year
at the 2024 MediaWeek Awards. At the heart of it all is a relentless drive to push boundaries, tell bold stories, and connect brands to youth culture like no one else can.

About The Role

Our commercial team is looking for an Associate Creative Director
who understands what makes young women laugh, gets them talking, and matters to them. With a focus on Betches UK, this is an opportunity to shape bold, funny, culturally relevant content that connects with a Gen Z audience.

We’re looking for someone with a passion for women’s issues and lifestyle, a sharp sense of humour, and the ability to turn audience insights into standout, social-first branded content.
You’ll define what great looks like across both partnership campaigns and platform output, guiding the team from initial spark through to delivery.

You’ll lead creative ideation across short-form video, memes, reactive content and talent-led formats, creating work that feels native, entertaining and true to Betches UK’s voice. From dating and friendships to careers, pop culture and the issues shaping women’s lives, you’ll know how to find the relatable truth and turn it into something worth sharing.

This role sits at the heart of the team, leading and inspiring a multidisciplinary group of creative producers, editors, creators, and talent partners to deliver work that earns attention and drives real impact.

What The Opportunity Looks Like

Lead the creative development of women’s lifestyle branded content, with a focus on BETCHES UK, ensuring ideas feel native to the platform and true to the brand’s voice.
Apply and evolve successful content formats into partnership work, while developing new formats that connect with young women.
Oversee creative output across owned social channels, ensuring consistency, quality and platform relevance.
Own the end-to-end creative output, maintaining a high standard across both always-on content and campaign moments.
Shape and manage the idea pipeline, balancing reactive content with bigger, format-led executions.
Champion humour and an authentic female perspective, finding fresh ways to reflect the experiences, interests and issues that matter to our audience.
Lead, mentor and inspire the wider creative team, providing clear direction and elevating the quality of ideas and execution.
Act as the senior creative voice in client conversations, turning briefs into strong, simple ideas and presenting them clearly and confidently.
Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure ideas are both ambitious and deliverable within fast-paced production timelines.
Stay tapped into Gen Z culture, platform trends and audience behaviour, ensuring all output feels current and relevant.

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

Significant experience within a social-first creative, editorial or advertising environment, operating at a senior or leadership level.
A proven track record of developing standout branded content that feels native to the platform, with a portfolio that demonstrates a strong instinct for humour.
A passion for women’s issues and lifestyle, with an understanding of the different perspectives and experiences within a young female audience.
Deep Gen Z cultural fluency, from creators and internet humour to the conversations shaping young women’s lives.

Position at Logitech:

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The Team And Role:

A leader in sustainability, Logitech designs software-enabled hardware solutions in pursuit of our mission to extend human potential in work and play.

Our Creative & Design team delivers award-winning design and creative excellence.

The Associate Creative Director is a strategically minded, hands-on creative who works closely with the Creative Director to raise the ambition, originality and effectiveness of Logitech’s creative output.

You will help shape how the brand shows up across campaigns, content and experiences, bringing together strong ideas, distinctive art direction and exceptional craft. You will be equally comfortable developing a big idea, shaping a visual world, challenging and refining creative, and getting into the detail to make the work better.

Working across Logitech Personal Workspace (PWS) and with teams across the business, you will help create attention grabbing work and creative experiences that are culturally relevant, strategically grounded and distinctly Logitech.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.

In this role you will:

Shape creative ideas: Develop original, strategically grounded ideas that bring Logitech’s brand, products and business ambitions to life. Push beyond the expected to create work that is distinctive, relevant and memorable.
Raise the creative bar: Work closely with the Creative Director to elevate the quality, ambition and originality of our creative output. Bring a critical eye to ideas and execution, knowing when to challenge, refine or push further.
Be hands-on: Concept, art direct and design integrated creative across campaigns, content, social, digital, photography, film and other brand experiences. Remain close to the work from initial idea through to final execution.
Build compelling creative worlds: Develop strong visual and conceptual systems that give campaigns a distinctive point of view and create consistency across multiple channels and markets.
Champion the brand: Help evolve and strengthen Logitech’s creative expression, ensuring work feels unmistakably Logitech while remaining fresh, contemporary and culturally relevant.
Collaboration is key: Partner with writers, designers, strategists, marketers, producers and external creative partners to turn ambitious ideas into exceptional work. Help create an environment where the best idea wins.
Present and influence: Clearly articulate creative thinking, concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners are what helps Logitech succeed. So build confidence in the work and use feedback to make it stronger.
Put the consumer first: Develop a strong understanding of consumer mindsets, behaviours and cultural context to create work that is meaningful, useful and engaging.
Bring craft and detail: Have a deep appreciation for design, typography, photography, film, motion, digital and emerging forms of creative expression. Know that great ideas only become great work through great execution.
Stay ahead of what’s next: Keep close to culture, creativity, technology, AI and emerging creative tools. Experiment with new ways of working and look for opportunities to make our work more innovative and effective.
Champion creative ambition: Bring energy, curiosity and a restless desire to make work that stands out, earns attention and moves the brand forward.

Key Qualifications:

For this position we are looking for you to demonstrate:

10+ years of experience with a standout portfolio of original, strategically grounded, big idea driven advertising, brand and engagement work. B2C experience is essential, with B2B experience a huge plus.
A strong track record of developing and delivering high-quality integrated creative across campaigns, film/video, social, digital, photography, experiential and non-traditional media.
Exceptional conceptual and art direction skills, with the ability to turn strategic challenges into simple, compelling and distinctive creative ideas.
A high level of craft and a strong understanding of how to take an idea from initial thought through to polished final execution.
Experience working with and influencing senior creative, marketing and cross-functional stakeholders, with the ability to clearly articulate creative strategy, narrative and ideas.
Strong presentation skills and the confidence to champion creative thinking while remaining open to feedback and collaboration.
Experience working across complex, multi-channel and global brand environments, with an understanding of how to create work that can scale without losing its creative impact.
Deep production and post-production knowledge across video, CG, photography, print and digital, with the ability to collaborate effectively with production partners and specialists.
A genuine passion for advertising, design, popular culture, technology and emerging creative trends.
A strong interest in AI and emerging creative technologies, and an appetite for exploring how they can unlock better ideas, faster workflows and new forms of creative expression.
A collaborative, curious and generous creative partner who can build strong relationships across disciplines and bring people with them.
A restless drive to create truly outstanding, culturally resonant work.

jobs.title: Technical Content Lead
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself.
Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar.
The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar.
Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not.
You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad
Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop
3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't
Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow
Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses
Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times
Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries
Fluent English

Good to Have

You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube
Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure
Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents
You can shoot and cut video yourself
Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience

Benefits

Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography
Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one
All the tokens you need, across all frontier models
Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement
Colleagues in 12+ countries

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it
Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it
International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries
Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours
Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount
Your name on the work: you build your own audience on company time, and we want you to
Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room

😡 What you might not love

Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done
Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time
You will kill a lot of your own output: accurate and lifeless still goes in the bin
Judged on output, not architecture: an elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure

Hiring Process

15-minute phone screen - with a founder
Short Assignment
Craft deep dive (90 min)
Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Preferred: Familiarity with ad libraries, customer-review research, Reddit, Amazon reviews, TikTok research, and competitor analysis.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We're looking for a Specialist, Creative Strategy to lead day-to-day creative execution for Darkroom's social programs — both paid social advertising and organic content - across a portfolio of client accounts. You're comfortable diving into the feed and the ad account alike, giving tactical, platform-native feedback on statics, hooks, pacing, captions, and edit structure for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram. You're likely a Creative Strategist, Social Strategist, or Video Editor by trade, with hands-on experience shipping content that performs, not just looks good.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service — our AI-powered creative engagement for paid and organic social — helping clients increase the diversity and volume of their creative program (upwards of 50+ new assets per month) while keeping every piece grounded in what's actually driving hooks, watch time, and conversion.

You'll work daily alongside Designers, Editors, and Creative Strategists to keep the social and paid social creative pipeline moving — briefing assets, giving feedback, and translating client goals and platform data into concepts that ship on time and drive results.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).

What You'll Do

Manage day-to-day creative execution for paid social and organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts
Brief and direct Designers and Editors on statics, motion, short-form video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure
Copywriting: Own creative copy for US-based clients, flexing in tone of voice according to platform and purpose, threading the needle when clients ask you to “punch up the copy
Own the testing and content calendar cadence — what ships, in what order, against what hypothesis or content pillar
Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction
Partner with Paid Media to identify organic winners worth scaling into paid, and with Social Commerce on creator and UGC briefs
Maintain quality and consistency across a high volume of social creative output, flagging risk to timelines or scope early
Present creative and content work to clients and internal stakeholders with clarity and rationale
Use AI-assisted tools (e.g. FLORA, Midjourney, Runway, Claude) to increase the speed and volume of output

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

4+ years managing or leading creative execution for paid social and/or organic social programs, ideally at an agency
Hands-on with short-form video, statics, and platform-native content for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram — you can storyboard, cut, and ship, not just direct
Comfortable jumping into Figma, Premiere, or Photoshop yourself when needed — this isn't a strategy-only role
Fluent in both paid and organic metrics (CTR, hook retention, watch time, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) and use them to decide what to make next
A clear, proactive communicator who gives crisp feedback to designers and editors and can present to clients
Already using AI tools to speed up and scale creative production
A portfolio showing paid and/or organic social work with real performance or engagement context

Hard Disqualifiers

No hands-on experience shipping paid or organic social creative (design, video, or content)
No portfolio link or no performance/engagement context
Strategy-only with no execution ability
Not comfortable presenting work to clients

What It's Like To Work At Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Das erwartet Dich, Das bringst Du idealerweise mit, Was wir Dir bieten, Start, Wir suchen eine kreative und konzeptionell starke Persönlichkeit als Creative Director (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf FMCG CULINARY
. Du bringst umfangreiche Erfahrung in ganzheitlichem Brand Design, der Entwicklung und Gestaltung umfassender Produktportfolios, Markenidentitäten, Kampagnen sowie im Packaging Design mit und führst dein Team souverän von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Du arbeitest mit einem vielfältigen Kundenportfolio – von internationalen Marken bis hin zu Start-ups – und hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Trends und 360° Markenerlebnisse.

Entwicklung ganzheitlicher Markenstrategien und deren Übersetzung in kreative Konzepte sowie konsistente Designsysteme
Gestaltung von Marken über Positionierung, Storytelling, Packaging, digitale Touchpoints und umfassende 360° Erlebnisse hinweg
Führung deines Teams durch konzeptionelle Prozesse hin zu klaren, wirkungsvollen Ergebnissen
Inszenierung von Marken am Point of Sale, digital sowie in Bewegtbildformaten
Souveräne Präsentation von Konzepten und Ergebnissen gegenüber Kund:innen und intern
Planung von Workshops und Begleitung von Projekten bis zur finalen Umsetzung (inkl. Shootings)

,

Mehr als 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Brand Design FMCG CULINARY
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Steuerung umfassender Produktportfolios, Markenidentitäten, Kampagnen und Packaging Design
Starke Fähigkeiten in Strategie, Konzeptentwicklung und kreativer Ideenfindung
Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams und der Steuerung konzeptioneller Prozesse
Souverän im Umgang mit Kund:innen, Präsentationen und Workshops
Fundierte Kenntnisse in KI-gestützten Designtools (z. B. Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, VEO 3)
Erfahrung im Motion Design (z. B. After Effects oder vergleichbar)
Fließende Englischkenntnisse
Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist
Ein Portfolio, das deine konzeptionelle Stärke und Design-Exzellenz klar belegt, einschließlich ganzheitlicher und 360° Markenarbeit

,

Spannende Projekte mit namhaften FMCG-Marken
Kurze Entscheidungswege
Individuelle Weiterentwicklung über unsere RK Academy
Individuelle Arbeitszeitmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten (Büro & Remote)
Ein herzliches Team, flache Hierarchien und offene Kommunikation
Ein inspirierendes, kreatives Umfeld mit viel Raum für Ideen
Eine Unternehmenskultur, die auf Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und Miteinander setzt

Wir arbeiten vernetzt, agil und auf Augenhöhe – mit Kolleg:innen, Führungskräften und Kund:innen. Wir glauben an ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem kluge und kreative Köpfe sich einbringen und weiterentwickeln können., ab sofort
